title: Ignite Starter Slate — compact onboarding mosaic and code-shots for Hosted API
creator: Asha Verma
description: Create a compact, mobile-first mosaic of onboarding screenshots and code-shot assets that demonstrate the Hosted API model selection, request-builder UI, and copy-paste ready code snippets. Deliverables include a tiled hero image for docs, individual frame exports for the quickstart flow (model picker -> request builder -> run response streaming), and annotated callouts for the developer docs. Assets must be export-ready for docs (1200x630), docs gallery (800x450), and small in-app tooltips (360x640).
acceptance_criteria: Docs hero image (1200x630) exported and uploaded to docs repo
Three flow frames exported at 800x450 and 360x640 with annotated callouts added
JS and Python code-shots use final API pattern and copy cleanly into README snippets
Design handoff includes alt text and responsive cropping guidelines
PM and Eng review completed and feedback addressed
design_notes: Prioritize visual clarity for model labels: short name + capability tag + latency badge
Use compact code-shots with 3–4 lines of boilerplate and one real example request/response
Request builder frames should show both streaming and non-streaming toggle state
Avoid using the term 'hostedapi' in embedded text; display as 'Hosted API' for docs consistency
Provide dark and light variants for the 360x640 mobile export
